messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: GPU queue growth detected in westeurope (ams2) pool. queue_length > 3000 and autoscaler has repeatedly failed to provision. severity=high :rotating_light:

Sandeep: seeing it — requests piling up, latency climbing. autoscaler logs show cloud response QUOTA_EXCEEDED for new instances.

Rachel: confirmed from dashboards — per-token latency > 4s and 5xx rate for hosted API routes up ~12%. CS reported a few customers hitting timeouts.

Sandeep: quick context — last successful scale up was 07:12 UTC. At 07:18 autoscaler tried to add 6 nodes, provider returned quota failure. Queue backlog grew from ~400 -> 3k in 25m.

ops-alex: pasting the autoscaler error snippet:

```
2026-03-15T07:18:22Z autoscaler: scale_up_attempt region=westeurope requested=6 gpu_type=NCv3 cloud_err=QuotaExceeded code=403
2026-03-15T07:18:22Z autoscaler: retry=3 wait=30s
2026-03-15T07:21:28Z autoscaler: scale_up_failed reason=QUOTA_EXCEEDED
```

infra-nina: Azure support case opened (case 20260315-AX-9987). Support says quota for NCv3 in westeurope is at hard cap for the subscription; quoted response time ~2h for provisioning.

Sandeep: mitigation plan now — 1) enable regional fallback to eu-north1 2) throttle low-tier requests (apply 503 for non-critical) 3) reduce max_tokens and smaller batch sizes globally to free capacity.

Rachel: I can flip QoS throttles and bump deprioritize rules. Doing a controlled throttle now for Trial and Free customers. Expect drop in overall RPS ~18%.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback of recent model-routing change completed to reduce burstiness (route returns to model-v3-stable -> model-v3-small).

Sandeep: good. ops-alex please start reroute of spare capacity to eu-north1 (fallback pool). Confirm no cross-VC connectivity issues.

ops-alex: starting reroute — creating new nodepool in eu-north1 and updating routing policy. Running `./infra tools region-fallback --from=westeurope --to=eunorth1 --dryrun=false`

ops-alex: note — capacity in eunorth1 is limited too but has ~40 GPUs free. Will take ~8m to spin up.

customer-success-luis: flagging customer impact: 3 enterprise customers (Acme, Tesseract Labs, NovaForms) reported elevated error rates and one support ticket about inference timeouts. Preparing customer comms draft.

Sandeep: action: open incident ticket, add RCA owners, set priority=P1. Creating incident doc and timeline.

Rachel: throttle in place — we see immediate queue reduction from 3k -> 1.8k over 4m. Latency trending down but still elevated.

infra-nina: Azure support updated — they can increase quota if we move to a different subscription/ billing boundary but that requires org-level change; still multi-hour. They offered temporary burst allocation only for specific customers (requires manual approval).

Sandeep: okay, next steps: 1) finish region fallback, 2) keep throttles, 3) open partner channel with Azure and request expedited quota for the dedicated subscription for our enterprise customers, 4) prepare rollback plan for heavy batch callers.

ops-alex: region fallback done — traffic rerouted ~60% to eunorth1. queue_length now ~650, avg_wait ~22s.

Rachel: handing off to @rachel for on-call cover. Sandeep will pivot to cloud escalation with infra-nina + luis for customer comms.

Sandeep: acknowledged handoff. Rachel please continue watch for 30m and escalate if queue >1000 or 5xx >5%.

Rachel: taking over. Monitoring live dashboards and logs. Added short note to incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4909812345 (will update timeline).

customer-success-luis: drafting comms now — will call top impacted customers and give ETA ~2h pending Azure case. Will offer SLA credits where appropriate.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled autoscaler tuning release delayed — removing from today's rollout until incident closed.

Rachel: current status summary: fallback active -> eunorth1 absorbing 60% traffic; throttles reducing non-critical load; queue down to 420 and falling; Azure quota escalation open. No data breach or persistence issues. Continuing to monitor.

Sandeep: closing note — postmortem and quota mitigation plan required: add multi-subscription fallback, automated provider quota check during scale attempts, and per-customer burst allowances. Assigning owners in doc.

Rachel: will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
